notes.title: Regular update of the full version is out now!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Thanks to the great feedback we received from you we are bringing a new update with fixes and new features requested by players.

Improvements:


  Shopping with multiple player units
  Automatic healing is activated at 33% of unit health or is used as an extension to amount of health 
a unit has - thus it can withstand blows that would kill it before
  Optimisation and proper spawning of enemies in Mission 01
  Optimisation and improved behavior of enemies in Mission 02
  Improved overall gameplay and enemy behavior in Mission 05
  Inter-level transferring limits for guns and ammo fixed and optimized
  Improved gun and properties of Assault vehicle
  Vehicles don`t slow down when damaged. Although reasonable, in fact, it harms gameplay
  Improved Anika`s paralyzation particle effects
  Highlighting control desks of city gates in Skirmish Mission 02
  Rebaked lightmaps for Mission 04

Fixed bugs:

  Missing health bar of Mobile refinery
  Missing health-bars of city gates in Skirmish Mission 02
  Incorrect navigations and collisions in Mission 03 and 04
  Units with a mobile gun were missing "Enter the vehicle" button
  Unit dropping a mobile gun after reviving companion
  Shortcut Alt+F9 causing crash

notes.title: Regular update of the full version is out now!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Our top priority is to deliver a great gaming experience to our players. In this effort, we are bringing a major update with improvements and fixes based on the performance of the game among players after lunch. Many thanks for your feedback, you are helping us to perfect this game. 

Addressed issues:


Bugs:

  Knocked-out enemies rarely fell into the surrounding geometry in such an unfortunate way, that they got invisible.
  Searching issue in "Petrol Quest" from mission 02
  Units carrying a mobile-mounted gun would lose it under some rare conditions.
  Automatic healing now works differently. Before a unit had to survive an attack to apply a medkit afterwards. Now a medkit in personal inventory effectively extends the unit's health. The unit can take damage, that would be lethal otherwise.
  Silent eradication of stunned enemies is now really silent.
  Unwanted open fire after Knockout
  Infinitely looping Alarm Music
  Incorrect navigation and collisions in several missions

Improvements:

  Improved gameplay of the first mission
  Extended Inventory tutorial
  Extended Weapons description
  "Sell all tradeable items" button
  Inventory slots description
  New obtained skill notification icon
  More noticeable visual information of the alert
  Units remember crouch/stealth command after leaving a cover.
  A synchronized transition between Run and Crouch

notes.title: Gray Zone Leaves Early Access on Steam Today
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We are delighted to announce that Gray Zone, a story-driven tactical RTS with stealth and RPG elements, is leaving Early Access on Steam today. The full version of the game costs $19.99 USD.

The story campaign contains 8 - 12 hours. The games provide both action and a stealthy mode of play. The gameplay is enriched with two skirmish missions.
The original soundtrack for the game costs $2.99 USD.

You can look forward to at least 15 hours of entertaining gameplay throughout 7 story missions and 2 challenging skirmish actions.

Enjoy a deep story and dialog, eye-catching fauna and flora, and a custom vision & elevation system.

Don't forget to share your feedback with us.

Best Regards!

notes.title: Developers Diary #03
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

After a few months of hard work, we’re heading towards the finalisation of our project - Gray Zone. It`s exciting that it will become the Gold/Final, completed version of the game, so you can look forward to a brand new story mission with all included game features.
The game is scheduled for release at the end of February. There’s a lot of game-play testing ahead of us to eliminate any issues that may be found. Together with polishing of the environment we’re finishing the last story comics as well.

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36429485/bff6a564595aa0e443c93599841dd77ac5e332fe.jpg



Mission 7 – Camouflage
The Union`s humanitarian convoy, sent to help the rebels turned out to be fake. Their intention is to secure the research centre surroundings and to seize the rare artefacts and information contained there. A scout team of rebels fall into the trap. Your goal is to cross over the river which is heavily guarded by Union troops, save the scouts from enemy fire and enter the scientific centre. Along the way you will come across a village of miners where you can replenish your supplies as well an opportunity to help the locals. There are number of optional quests available that will add at least 2 hours of additional game-play.

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36429485/9c85ab64e567c45c0085ac45949e55491da155a6.jpg



Ending the story
As the first chapter of the game is reaching its conclusion, two full animated comics will finish telling the story. Valern is advancing with his mission to find out something more about his origins and find a way to liberate the enslaved people of the 7th tribe from the planet Korath. 

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36429485/28de6bde2ea597b0782bcd51a01a0a4f931a6dbc.jpg



New items and guns
Enjoy more looting of treasures and corpses. With new items you can pack the inventory even more, either using the items along the way or selling them for money. 

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36429485/3d500d27e6d4e5f4dbcccae7b7733350a4f9b915.jpg

You will surely need all the money you can make because shops provide a wide range of new powerful rifles and machineguns. Other objects you come across can help you in different ways such as helping to heal your injuries. 

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36429485/af0e84cd4bfe20beb150ad66b91d0ca6af8d46a1.jpg

notes.title: GRAY ZONE MAJOR UPDATE
notes.content:
Embark on the great adventure of Valern, a slave in the hands of a corrupt government, and explore colonized planets as you command your heroes to complete story objectives.

Gray Zone features 2D Artwork and comics that chronicle the story’s progress between missions. The game also contains its own electro-orchestral soundtrack. 

As the development of Gray Zone progresses, mission 7 and Skirmish will be integrated into the current chapter of the game. 3 additional chapters will be released as standalone, episodic game content. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36429485/d5c5056300e592fe5803a1c6748e5d5043d1a476.gif
•	New Update 
•	Game size reduced by 3,5 GB (video subtitles)
•	Weapons can be stored in quick inventory
•	Units collect experience and are leveling up
•	Heroes can earn specific skills and enhance their effectiveness in battle
•	Automated looting
•	Item exchange between two units based on their locality
•	Small not interactive animals implementation/snake, fish, bugs, scorpions
•	Mission 6 - new playable mission with 1,5 - 2 hours of game-play
•	Mission 6 - full animated comics
•	Animation updates - upgraded animations with heavy weapons
•	Enhanced Stealth mode with visualization of angle of view for enemies --- very important, game changing feature, drastically enhanced game-play, better approachable for newcomers, more fun for hardcore players 
•	Redesigned Enemies alertness information
•	Item exchange between two units based on their locality with the possibility to buy for money
•	New items in looting/trade/exchange
•	Use stone to distract enemies
•	Ability to level up heroes and to buy new Skills for experience points
•	New tutorials
•	Players can shop for items or sell them for money in several markets in each mission
•	Existing levels have been visuals improved and updated with new situations and story elements
[previewyoutube=Kt_BQBrqpGQ;full][/previewyoutube]
Features
•	Mixture of some old school and fresh new mechanics.
•	Full real-time battles with a 'tactical pause' at your service.
•	Utilize your team, equipment and environment to get advantage over your enemies.
•	Expect diversity in units, weapons, vehicles and more.
•	Unique enemies and boss encounters
•	Partially destructible environments
•	Eye-catching fauna and flora
•	Custom vision & elevation system
•	Stealth and cover-ups
•	Vehicles & machines

notes.title: Developers update
notes.content:
Hello there once again! 

 As we mentioned once, we stopped updating the image with what we’re planning on doing for each month. We found it too static and it didn’t engage our community as much as we would like so we made a decision. We came up with another way of how to inform our players about what’s going on in our game development kitchen. We’re sure many of you heard about Trello, which will be, from now on, a place for you, our players, to see what’s really going on. You will find new ideas that we have, small things we’re working on and others there. As always, we love your feedback, which is why you can easily write your ideas, complaints or show us some love through Discord. 

If you want to access our Trello Roadmap click here or you want to be part of our Discord community click here.

We’re also about to show you a bit of what we’ve been working on these days. 

 New items 

Working on new items is never a bad idea. That's why we’re working on new items which the player will be able to find while looting or by searching for them in missions. They’re being implemented to each mission step by step nevertheless it will take more time to make it just fine.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36429485/46ae1b629f4cbff8a4df286e7d2d9aa7f16fe89d.jpg


 Enemy’s reaction to the raised alarm. 

Last bigger challenge, which we’re testing, is the enemy’s reaction in different situations during the battle or crawling. We’re tuning the battle to be amusing but also challenging for the player.

Lastly, we save the best thing for the end. As we mentioned earlier, we’re planning on testing the newest version with the help of a new Steam tool. It’ll be a new experience not for us, but also for our players. This testing will of course need feedback from the players which will be rewarded with a full version of our game for free. All the details will be published on our Discord server.

notes.title: Developers Diary #02
notes.content:
Hello to you all! 

It’s been a month since we last updated you on what we’re working on. To sum it up, we devoted a lot of time to the behavior of the enemy while the alarm is going down. We’re successfully working on the 7th mission of the first chapter and there are many small changes that were implemented. There is a big testing and bug fixing period ahead of us for May. We also believe that there will be a new major update available on steam next month.

To jump right in, this is what we’ve been working on!

Catching the eye of your enemy by simple stone throw.
If the player prefers sneaking, there is a slight chance that in some moments the enemy will need to be distracted in order to look the other way. That’s the most secure way for players to sneak unseen. But pay attention to this warning, we do not recommend throwing more stones one after another, this will cause the enemy to spot the player.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36429485/7eb68fe34f291c41c29186891260e5ab732e5c6e.gif


Unsuccessful stone throw is now impossible.
You guessed it right! In the current version, there was a slight bug. When the player threw the stone, it sometimes did not word properly but in the new one the problem doesn’t exist! Unit calculates the throw and each one becomes successful. Amazing, isn’t it?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36429485/2f8f5afa94d06849f58e3838c042dd62110492c4.gif

New items which can be claimed by looting or found in treasures.
We’re adding new tokens which give looting better sense. They can be used by players as equipment of troops or can be sold in shops.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36429485/b181031f6129c1028d71f0eb460f41b56f5cfd69.jpg

New graphics of items and icons.
The old graphics of items were not so pleasing, at least for us. We devoted some time and now they look even better.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36429485/a92ca031598588679b2fc1b548214c190494a3b3.jpg


Skills menu.
In the new update, there will be Skills for Valern. New menu will contain unique skills. We have 5 occupations for heroes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36429485/30ba9bf9eba7c2cb597757c03a48da091821ba34.jpg

Ingame GUI improvements.
There is much work on GUI in our game in general but even in this case we made some improvements and we added some brand new commands and functions to Order but even in the Info Panel. For example, in the Info Panel the player can find info about Skill Points and Experience Levels. We added new functions like Stealthing to the Order panel.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36429485/e2b069cd64caf3b547d5799eb5208b07be20d3e9.jpg

Community testing.
We’re planning community testing in May through the Seam Playtest feature. We’re gonna inform you on our social media about the possibility to test our newest update. We are happy to hear your opinion/feedback.

notes.title: Developers Diary #01
notes.content:
Greetings our fellow Rebels and followers!

First of all, we would like to say big thank you to our fans for their long-lasting support and endurance while waiting for a new update. We’re working on a major game update which is taking much longer than we were expecting. When we say major, we mean that we’re on our way to advance GrayZone’s gaming experience.


What’s more, we are starting to write Developer Diaries, which will be an follow up on Roadmap or any other updates to summarize, what we’ve done and what you will see in next updates.

Present mission content was based primarily on action but the update we’re about to give you will not only offer the action but also “stealthing” experience. This will bring a new gaming experience along with collecting rewards in “XP” form. For this, we needed to imply bigger changes on missions such as adding bushes for hiding, adding objects, stones and old trees with the advantages for the player in hiding. These are the changes we made in “stealth“ mode:

Stealth zones throughout each mission
Game itself assists and hints the player on how to pass the mission and therefore earn reward in XP, if he doesn’t trigger an alarm while getting the treasure or accomplishing other tasks.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36429485/a9f9232afd3349c15f62bcb7c221d6c74a5c0b69.jpg

As we mentioned, the first major asset is collecting XP for each disarmed enemy. Getting more XP is possible if the player doesn’t trigger an alarm while accomplishing the task.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36429485/27155c4d9de789ae757aa759d34f190df4551f44.gif

Ability to see where our enemy is looking
To make attack from hiding even easier we included an “enemy’s sight radius” which is switched on automatically or by clicking on the particular enemy.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36429485/d30a3b14e1a098c44bca13e89af1bc3f3fe77057.gif

Sound visualisation
While sneaking around, it is very important to remain as silent as you can. If a player doesn’t care about crawling and runs around, this action has a harmful effect for visibility of his forces. If it runs, the sounds are louder which draws the attention of the enemy. This feature is still work in progress.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36429485/c0fab3704a73de42e472ebdf76711c76eff93926.gif

Automatic looting in close proximity
Making looting easier is a necessity which is why we added a feature of looting everything in close proximity. What the player needs to do is to point on the object of interest. Really useful thing.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36429485/00c4117127bcbadbcb276df1ecc725995e5ed11c.gif

Some other improvements:

Optimization of frame rate and dimensions
We managed to boost the framerate in each mission. The game is steadier even on older computers. Reducing build size by 3GB made it possible to take up less space on disc.

Small non-playable animals in the game.
There was an idea presented to us in one of the feedbacks and we accepted the challenge. In the next build, there will be a handful of small “decorative” animals such as birds, fish, bats, snakes and many more.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36429485/a5b637fe3ca4ff789b4bf292c81bd74515c0818c.gif

In the next dev report we’ll inform you about other changes we’ve made so far but need more time for now. We can mention things like throwing stones to catch the attention of the enemy or even new possibilities such as enhancing skills of players, disarming enemies, new prologue mission and many more.

Greetings our fellow Rebels and followers,

We've been working hard on some new stuff and we're excited to share it with you. So let's dive right into it, shall we?


Bad news - a lot of time wasted
Most of you might not have been aware of it, but in the last 7 months we've put a lot of time, energy and effort negotiating with various investors / publishers about financing our first game. We've attended many events and discussions that costed us a big chunk of time we could have put elsewhere - into the development of course. Due to this matter, a lot of content we've wanted to release this year was either delayed or cut out completely. Good news - development status

On the flip side, we obtain resources for the development from outsourcing projects and contracts. This provides us with complete independence, although, we can't afford to enlarge our development teams from such profits.

Tutorial mission
Bringing a tutorial / prologue mission is still part of the plan. As a matter of fact, we've already designed some core gameplay. A goal of the tutorial mission is to guide player through the game's mechanics which will allow the player to adapt and master them on a deeper level.

Achievements Implementation
After-mission statistics are part of a bigger plan and it directly connects to achievements. Some basic ones have already been added. Do you have ideas for some cool achievements? Let us know.

Finish line
In any case, we will definitely finish Chapter 1 in our section and we will be looking for alternatives that will allow us further continuation on the project. Don't forget to give us feedback on Discord or Steam so we can constantly improve the game.

notes.title: Vote for us on Steam Awards 2020 - Outstanding visual style
notes.content:
Attention Rebels,

Steam Awards 2020 are behind the corner and we invite you to give us a vote for an outstanding visual style.

Many talented graphics artists had worked on this project to bring this high quality and we believe Gray Zone offers unique visuals.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36429485/a905afb8b7076a781e22a93ac197ed5623952482.jpg

Our graphical pipeline
We want to give you some insights on how we've created the graphics for Gray Zone.

Technology used
We used the latest software available in computer graphics such as Autodesk 3ds Max, Substance Painter, Blender, Adobe Photoshop & Pixologic ZBrush.

Models for most 3D objects were made in 3ds Max but some were made in Blender.

ZBrush allowed us to create high-poly models and sculpt them with greater details using specialized masks.

Textures were made in Substance Painter and Photoshop.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36429485/5eaf83f7704687105834e48f982985d5552a8445.jpg

PBR textures
Every 3d object in Gray Zone contains a texture which represents it's color and behavior in various light conditions. The texture is composed of multiple components or layers and they allow objects to define their reflection, diffusion, metallicity and so on. For this, we use a standard approach called PBR - Physically based rendering.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36429485/fa73ba8bf3f19b6a121dde2f8c86a1d1066b9462.jpg

Lighting
Number one most important factor when talking about computer graphics is definitely lighting. Quality of light and shadow plays a big role when trying to achieve realistic visuals.

Lights & shadows can be processed in either real-time or pre-baked.

In case of Gray Zone, calculating all lights and shadow casts in real-time is too exhaustive and unnecessary. This is why we've chosen the second approach - baked lighting.

Baked lighting essentially means that all information about lights and shadows is calculated and saved beforehand, in the Unity engine. It has a huge impact in a form of a performance boost since lights & shadows of most objects don't need to be re-calculated in-game.

There is one additional upside to the baked lighting - indirect lighting. Since we use PBR, some objects can reflect light in different angles and produce additional indirect lighting on other objects in proximity. This adds another level of realism into the scene. Specifically, Baked Global Illumination is the technical term. Such high physically-based quality is not achievable in the real-time process unless you use Ray Tracing.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36429485/a450c3ee052255afc72cea3985762406b5566d42.jpg

Post-processing
The last key element to our pipeline we'd like to mention is custom post-processing tool which allows us to further tweak and calibrate aspects such as color palette, intensity of shadows, ambient occlusion etc.

notes.title: Change of plans: Release update, G.Round program & 30% discount
notes.content:
Dear rebels,

We, the Gray Zone Team, as well as you - our brave protectors of freedom and peace, have fought hard battles. And for the right cause, no doubt. After all, we are in this together, aren't we?

With this short [not really] announcement, we'd like to inform you about some important changes concerning the date of a full release.

What has changed
Brand new tutorial mission: Play as The Union!
We've decided to create a completely new 'Tutorial/Intro' mission where you play as our antagonist - wait for it - The Union. What we are talking about is a 'bigger' mission where the most basic and advanced mechanics of the game will be explained in detail.
Why tutorial mission?
Entire available feedback and player experience that we have at our disposal has been considered. Clearly, most players are not aware of all the capabilities that the Gray Zone offers. There are situations, where the player knows about a certain feature but doesn't know how to properly utilize it, which is a problem. In another scenario the player is not aware of the feature at all which is even worse.

The Gray Zone offers quite complex system and AI. The 'Tutorial' mission will allow us to properly introduce and explain everything necessary. This will also allow us to remove the tiny bits of tutorial from the story mode, which will increase the dynamics of the game flow.

Of course, Covid situation and scarce resources impact the development process and the release date delay as well. We've been negotiating with investors for the last few months and it is on the right track.

Czech & Slovak Games Week: 30% discount [Oct 36 - Nov 02]
As taking part in the Czech & Slovak Games Week event, we've put a 30% discount on the early access version of Gray Zone. Don't hesitate and check the full list of awesome games made by our fellow brothers & sisters.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36429485/2db36c51a6e66d716db6cb032d182d964c7c1c8f.jpg

Gray Zone has recently joined the G.Round program. It is a game testing platform driven by the community. You can register on the platform for free and get access to the exclusive extended demo version of Gray Zone which also includes the first skirmish mission in a style of a sandbox.

notes.content:
Rebels, unite!

Your sanctuary, the Rab, is under attack. Do you have what it takes to defend it from waves of enemy forces?

Thank you!
First of all, we'd like to thank anyone who have tried our demo in the last couple of weeks. With the new update, the demo has been also updated and a new shop is now available in the first story mission. You can find it in the camp where Breg takes you.

Skirmish #2
Task in hand, commander. Your job in this situation is crystal clear. Defend the Rab at all cost and protect its civilians. Six heavy machine guns are at your disposal. Hire additional soldiers in the heart of Rab if you need to. You can also exchange your credits for ammunition, medical equipment and even weapons!

City gates - there is a control terminal for each gate, interact with it to open / close the gate, you may want to scavenge bodies for additional ammunition and supplies.

notes.title: Introducing Skirmish! Update 1.3 + 40% OFF
notes.content:
To all rebels: fasten your seatbelts and join the ride!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36429485/93a43881d0055884502652c9b05902fdf44144ed.jpg
Skirmish
We are happy to inform you, that the first skirmish map has been released. We know you've been waiting for this for quite some time, but we wanted to make sure that everything clicks right. Hopefully, the time has paid off. We've really pushed ourselves to the edge of a knife to bring you the best possible experience.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36429485/e8ed39b8e9a9181a9df9ea181b363e17a6029882.jpg

Beware though, it's no ordinary skirmish you might've been used to in other titles. Not even close. Many secrets and hidden opportunities lies ahead. Prepare for an intense action & somewhat hard challenges. You have been warned!
One hint: a few 'things' had been scattered around the desert which might come handy if you are able to find them.

notes.title: Skirmish coming soon!
notes.content:
Greetings to all rebels, fans and followers, we have some exciting news for you!

We decided to make a small change in our Roadmap. We have been working on polishing the game, fixing bugs and enhancing a gameplay even further. Instead of adding Data Leak (mission 6), we are about to release the first skirmish level in an upcoming update which will come in June, sooner or later. You can inspect our updated Roadmap below.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36429485/ca7bc7d8872bfd84d447a2042ab4924c2a77c31a.jpg
Skirmish

Skirmish is a new element which was originally not on the table before. However we believe that adding skirmish will significantly increase the value of replayability in the Gray Zone. We are curious about your ideas on behalf of this decision. Give us your opinions in the comment section. We'd also welcome feedback concerning skirmish once it is released. 

In our first skirmish level, you are able to roam freely across the entire map, just a small catch - first, you have to repel the attack of a mutant horde and if you succeed, strong emphasis on that 'IF', you may proceed to other parts of the level.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36429485/ee6a999d7515569c166e23a1bc5576a919c10b04.gif

We'll wrap it up right here, it wouldn't be fun if we have told you everything that is about to come.

notes.title: Update 1.2 released
notes.content:
Hi Everyone!

Firstly thank you for sharing your feedback on the game, the majority has been very positive which is really nice for us to hear, of course with any Early Access release there’s going to be a little rough with the smooth and we really appreciate you sharing the bug reports and quality of life suggestions and things like that, we’re pleased to announce our first update for Gray Zone will shortly be hitting Steam to update the game to version 1.2, below is a list of what this update addresses:

Please note, after Steam has updated you should see version number 1.2 in the lower right corner of the main menu.

Bug Fixes:

 Windows 7 support added
 Missing Autosaves added
 Misc Visual fixes
 Video format fix (Game data size reduction)


QOL:

 Graphics settings in menu
 Unity loader removed
 Union Scout Vehicles AI upgraded
 Quick Save/Load: F5/F9
 Improvement's to load/save UI function
 Language selection menu on first run


Misc:

 End Mission Statistics upgrade
 Animals/Creatures have more sounds
 Translations updated


If you reported a bug or suggested a QOL improvement and it’s not included above it doesn’t mean your voice wasn’t heard, simply that it may be coming in a later update.

Please keep those bug reports and feedback coming, it helps us a lot!

Thanks,

EastWorks Studio.

notes.title: Release window news and upcoming plans
notes.content:
We wanted to take the time to post a little update on our progress with the Early Access version of our upcoming game Gray Zone.

Firstly we wanted to say a big thank you to everyone who has followed the game on Steam, posted comments on Steam/YouTube/Social media etc. etc. it means a lot to us and keeps us energized and excited to show you our progress so far!

Obviously as everyone knows the world right now is going through an unprecedented situation that’s incredibly scary, but also creating a lot of changes in the way we live our lives and in particular how we do our work (for those who’re able to continue working remotely). 

One of the results of these changes over the last couple of weeks means that our upcoming Steam Early Access release of Gray Zone is currently being targeted for week commencing April 30th 2020, whilst I understand this will be disappointing to some people, please rest assured we won’t be resting our laurels and will be using the time to sneak in as much time polishing the gameplay and fixing bugs as possible!

We also wanted to provide a little window into what we’re planning for the first couple of weeks of April (or what has already happened behind the scenes):

 
    Teaser trailer focusing on a specific aspect of gameplay (First in a series).
    Localization completed into the announced 9 languages.
    Localization into Chinese (simplified) being worked on as we speak!
    New screenshots (and bonus comic page) to be released shortly.
    Game soundtrack made available on Steam as DLC.
(every purchase of the soundtrack will be used to further fund Gray Zone's development)
    Streamer build sent out to YouTube streamers of the different localized languages.
 

Thank you for your continued support and we look forward to sharing more news and content throughout the coming weeks.

Please, please, please stay safe out there, look after yourselves and your loved ones and try to stay calm and positive as we all look to get through these uncertain days and weeks ahead!
